title: Decide whether to launch to 50 enterprise accounts
label: 01 · The assignment
points: Ascend IQ should turn slow research into fast, source-supported answers.
50 accounts paying upwards of $50,000/year; engagement and retention are at risk.
Decision: SHIP the proposed rollout or HOLD it—and define what happens next.
impact: Recommendation: HOLD the unrestricted 50-account rollout; assess a narrower pilot against explicit entry criteria.
notes: Завдання — вирішити readiness broad rollout, не переказати курс. HOLD означає не схвалити необмежений запуск на наявних даних. Це не заборона всіх експериментів. Понад $2.5m account value не дорівнює forecast loss.

Відома pricing-помилка потребує rootcause й нового output. Legal refusal не окремий launch аргумент: він в appendix показує evaluator falsealarm.

title: A pricing failure does not automatically require a total shutdown
label: 03 · Management options
rows: Launch all capabilities to all 50 accounts now
Not supported: known defects and no corrected-build results against agreed criteria.
Hold every capability until all risks disappear
Too broad: we have not established that every capability is unsafe.
Hold broad launch; qualify a restricted pilot
Recommended next path: exclude affected scope, validate remaining tasks and demonstrate working controls.
impact: Decision: HOLD the proposed broad rollout. A restricted pilot needs its own approval; the current evidence does not yet justify starting it.
notes: Тут прибираємо circularreasoning: «Hard тому HOLD». Material pricing concern — potential wrongpurchasing, але одна помилка не доводить системність. Не видаємо disabledpricing за готове featureflag. Rootcause може бути sourcefreshness retrieval generation. M4 initial Hardpolicy переглядаємо для scope: failed pricing блокує candidate що включає pricing, не будь-який isolated scope.

title: Keep checks proportional to the risk and cost
label: 04 · Control plan · M3–M5
points: Pricing: current-source numeric check plus review of unsupported terms. Investigate retrieval and source freshness.
API: validate meaning against specifications; exclude automated comparisons until fixed or safely routed.
Speed: time representative tasks. Slang warns; policy-compliant refusal passes.
Budget: $155,000 online; $168,250 total planned. Online cap $200,000. Weekly audits accept detection delay.
impact: Supports a feasible control plan—not launch readiness. Confirm implementation and staffing before relying on these protections.
notes: M5 dollars — listed costs planning. $85k fabrication+$70kcontext155k. Toneaudit6500 bias5500 timer1250total168250. Це не гарантія і не proof controls працюють. M4 speed2s vs M5 longtask10s distinct. Correctlegalrefusal PASS за policy, slangeditable warning. Не приховуємо M2 API P0/M4Soft: не допускаємоunmitigated exposure.

title: HOLD broad rollout; return with a testable pilot proposal
label: 05 · Decision, owners and release conditions
headers: Evidence required for the next decision
rows: Engineering + pricing-data owner
Explain the pricing defect; fix or exclude affected functionality; confirm current source.
QA
Retest corrected outputs and representative in-scope tasks; report failures, timing and evaluator errors.
PM + Engineering
Define pilot scope, demonstrate exclusion/human routing and rollback; agree stop rules.
CPO + PM
Approve the scope-specific quality bar and review date. Start a pilot only after its entry criteria pass.
impact: What changes HOLD: passing results and working controls for an explicitly approved scope—not a relabeled old error or a written plan alone.
notes: Чіткий ask сьогодні: не approve broad50; призначити workowners і evidence reviewdate. Пілот може бути обмежений по accounts та capabilities, але його size/dateне вигадуємо. Hardbar0pricing застосовний коли scope включаєpricing; виключення лише при доведеному boundary й новомуapprovedcandidate. Далі масштабування based evidence, не автоматично.
